title: BRAND IDENTITY SYSTEMS
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 12 credits
description: Studio course that explores both the theory and the practice of brand identity systems, through the creation of a comprehensive visual branding project.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: GD 126.
A minimum grade of C- is required in GD 126.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
